Once a lion was sleeping in a forest. suddenly a mouse came there. It was, in fact, playing on a ro ee quite happily and didn't notice the sleeping lion. While running it accidentally bumps onto the lion which leads to the lion waking up. After seeing the mouse the lion ~~roars~~ roars with the irritation and rage and ~~asked~~ {inserted: told} the mouse "Give me a reason to not kill and eat you". Terrified the mouse starts to shake while looking at the lion and says, "Please spare my life. Who knows when I migh come handy to you?". After hearing what the mouse said he bursts out laughing while mocking the mouse, "What can a pathetie little mouse even help me with?" the lion says to the mouse while laughing and let the mouse of the hook. the mouse runs away after the lion releases him. Somedays later while the mouse was running here and there it happens to hear the lion's roar from a distance and decides to go and look. After some time the mouse sees the lion inside a netting. It was a trap set by the hunters. After seeing this the mouse doesn't hesitate even for a bit and rushes to help. It uses its sharp teeth {inserted: to} cut of the net and real releasing the lion.
